title: Google Cloud now offers OpenAI models alongside Gemini and Claude, becoming the only major provider with all three
text:
Google Cloud is the first major cloud provider to offer Gemini, Claude, and OpenAI's GPTs on a single platform. At launch, GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, and GPT-6 Luna are available as a private preview for enterprise customers.
The article Google Cloud now offers OpenAI models alongside Gemini and Claude, becoming the only major provider with all three appeared first on The Decoder.
